turns.text: I bet. Well, I hope you have a great evening after the meeting wraps up. Are you planning to do any rock climbing or play some guitar later to unwind?

turns.text: I think I'll just play some guitar tonight. My hands are a bit tired for climbing, so some music will be a nice way to relax. I'll catch up with you tomorrow!
